_help: Paste an ElevenLabs voice_id for each role you want voiced (Voice Library or your own voices). Roles left empty fall back to Narrator. Per-role 'settings' override 'defaults'. eleven_v3 accepts stability 0.0, 0.5 or 1.0 only.

Narrator.note: British English, warm and unhurried, intimate rather than announcer-like; the backbone of the book. Reads all narration,

Maren.note: Measured, precise, few words; dry humour at her own expense. Formal with superiors, blunt with peers. Under pressure her

Calder.note: Plain and earthy, a Saltreach farmer; wry, tired humour; swears mildly. Talks to animals like friends and argues with th

Orrun.note: The great lion. Slow and deep, like stone settling, with grief underneath. Few words. Must stay intelligible: deep, not

Aurveth.note: The oldest dragon. Long, measured, precise sentences; patient; guides rather than commands. An old woman's authority, ne

Kharrak.note: Broad, scarred, battle-trained. Short, hard bursts; fragments. Fierce, protective. Rough but not a monster voice.

Lisska.note: Lean, quick, restless; questions and teasing; jokes to avoid grief. Lighter and faster than the others.

Wren.note: Calder's daughter. A real child's voice: clear, direct, curious. Must sound nine.

Ada.note: Calder's mother. Knows the old songs; steady, dry, practical; can be sharp.

Bel.note: Calder's younger sister at Upper Rush. Quick, blunt; grief turns hard in her.

Joss.note: Bel's husband; breeds dray-beasts. Easy, practical.

Hob.note: Harrow's End miller. Prices are how he says hello; wheedling, shrewd.

Fisk.note: Old Fisk of the Eelweir; river man, sparing with words.

Hale.note: Warden Osric Hale. Kind, tired, carrying a secret; a scholar's care with words.

Pell.note: Weapons instructor. Grey, laconic, dry. 'Subdue. Don't kill.'

Rowan.note: Knight-Captain Ilse Rowan. Clipped, commanding, cold under pressure.

Thorne.note: Captain Marta Thorne of the Watch. Hard, plain-spoken.

Haverly.note: Lucan Haverly, the bonded rival. Gifted, certain, well-born; not cruel.

Tobin.note: Maren's friend. All elbows; loud about being unchosen; warm.

Ottery.note: Maren's old river-watch sergeant. Unhurried, gravelly, fond under it.

Liss.note: Maren's mother, the ferrywoman. Tells the river's stories; warm, weathered, knowing.

Tam.note: Maren's brother, a smith's apprentice. Eager, easily fired up.

Teo.note: Teo Varr, the younger son. Warm and well liked.

Arn.note: Arn Varr, the elder son. Proud, sharp, grieving.

Ulric.note: Ulric Varr, the uncle and warrior. Big, confident, dangerous.

Hallam.note: Hallam Brecc, oldest rider on the ledges. Slow, grave.

Sigrun.note: Sigrun Holm, Aurveth's rider. An old war-leader.

Imra.note: Imra Sallow, Lisska's rider. Quick and laughing.

Rook.note: A forgettable, pleasant voice that never rises; quietly menacing.

Corvin.note: Corvin Vale. Still, patient, never raises his voice. Same timbre as Cassian, colder.

Cassian.note: Cassian Vale, the public face. Same timbre as Corvin, warm and open: a speaker who wins crowds.

the Captain.note: Leader of the island hunters. Saltreach voice; curt.

Gannet.note: Saltreach boatman and poacher; a smile that arrives first.

Man 1.note: Shared voice for minor men (one of three, assigned by name so each minor speaker keeps one voice).

Man 2.note: Shared voice for minor men; contrast with Man 1 (age or weight).

Man 3.note: Shared voice for minor men; an older or rougher contrast.

Woman 2.note: Shared voice for minor women; contrast with Woman 1.

Child.note: Shared voice for minor children and boys (Davy, Pip, messenger boys). Different from Wren.
